printers.py.summary: The Printers class is a comprehensive iOS Smart app page object that extends SmartFlow and manages all printer-related UI interactions and workflows. It implements the Page Object Model pattern for test automation with extensive locator management through driver methods. Key features include: (1) Multi-modal printer discovery supporting WiFi, Ethernet, IP address, serial number, and Bonjour name searches; (2) Robust error handling with configurable timeouts and exception raising flags; (3) Platform-specific implementations for iOS and MAC with conditional logic; (4) Bidirectional scrolling for printer list navigation; (5) Retry mechanisms for flaky operations like MOOBE printer selection; (6) Comprehensive UI verification methods for all screens in the printer setup flow; (7) Bluetooth popup handling with conditional dismissal; (8) Analytics integration with dynamic printer count tracking; (9) Support for empty state, WiFi-off state, and connection troubleshooting screens; (10) Network permission and local network access handling. The class demonstrates advanced test automation patterns including wait strategies, dynamic element location with format specifiers, gesture-based interactions (swipe), and multi-attempt retry logic. It provides complete coverage of the printer management lifecycle from discovery through connection confirmation.
